mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN}, PantClass{NN}, GloveClass{NN}, BootClass{NN}. The numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes, so Class01 is the Dark Wizard, Class02 the Dark Knight and Class03 the Fairy Elf.
part_note: The arms and hands, 210 triangles. Bound to 39 on Bip01 L Hand, 39 on Bip01 R Hand, 28 on Bip01 L Finger0, 28 on Bip01 R Finger0, 27 on Bip01 L Forearm, 27 on Bip01 R Forearm.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass103.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Fairy Elf's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Fairy Elf body, read out of Data/Player/GloveClass03.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's GloveClass03 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
unstack_why: Refuses the UV un-stacking, as MuMain's part did and as the Dark Wizard's do: MU shares one set of texels between a left and a right half, and the un-stacking once moved half a mirrored torso's faces off their twin and lost its painting (ArmorClass01, 2026-09).
uv_overrides_why: The hands are bare; the bracers are lifted out as leather. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-15).
material_note: skin for the bare hands, leather for the bracers, by uv_overrides.
